title: Source-backed knowledge development
objective: Remember every public-safe lead, develop defensible claims from evidence, preserve uncertainty and collective credit, and project only claims that serve a defined public argument.

labels.2: structured but not ready for promotion
labels.4: complete, inspectable, recursively maintainable, and trustworthy

selection_order: smallest coherent correction that preserves evidence

hard_constraints: The public repository contains only public sources, public-safe summaries, protected opaque locators, and approved projections.
A recollection may create a claim lead or research task but cannot independently confirm a claim.
A source must be decomposed into what it supports, bounds, contradicts, contextualizes, or leaves open.
Claim maturity and projection status are independent decisions.
Collective work must name Jamie's contribution without erasing collaborators, institutions, movements, or formal decision-makers.
Negative searches are recorded as not recovered, never as proof that an artifact or event did not exist.
Photographs remain outside the public repository until rights, consent, context, and public-display review are complete.
The public website is a selective projection of the knowledge bank, not a mirror of it.

evals.title: Intake coverage and disposition
procedure: Inventory every intake item in the current batch.
Verify stable identity, provenance, status, and a linked disposition or explicit hold reason.
pass_criteria: No item is silently dropped.
Every decomposed or integrated item links to a source, claim, or research task.
Every held item records why.
evals.remediation_hint: Create or complete the intake record before developing more public copy.

evals.title: Public safety and provenance
procedure: Scan public-safe records for private paths, raw-source markers, credentials, and exposed protected locators.
Verify public URLs and citations for public sources.
pass_criteria: No private source material is exposed.
Every public source has a public URL and citation.
Every non-public source omits underlying URLs.
evals.remediation_hint: Replace raw material with a public-safe summary or opaque protected locator.

evals.title: Atomic source decomposition
procedure: For every newly integrated or queued public source, inspect its atomic source assertions.
Check that boundaries and open questions are represented where the source is incomplete.
pass_criteria: Every intake-linked source has at least one assertion.
Assertions identify their relationship and confidence.
A supplied URL alone does not become evidence for an unrelated claim.
evals.remediation_hint: Closely read the source and create atomic support, boundary, context, contradiction, or question records.

evals.title: Claim maturity integrity
procedure: Compare every claim's maturity and eligibility with its evidence relationships.
Verify that confirmed claims have direct support and research-needed claims remain held.
pass_criteria: No recollection-only claim is confirmed.
Every eligible claim is confirmed or confirmed with a boundary.
Every research-needed claim is held from projection.
evals.remediation_hint: Lower maturity or eligibility until the evidence supports promotion.

evals.title: Evidence graph integrity
procedure: Resolve every source, assertion, claim, task, correction, page, and occurrence reference.
Check stable-ID uniqueness within and across record classes.
pass_criteria: Every reference resolves.
No stable ID is duplicated.
Every page occurrence resolves to an eligible claim and cited source.
evals.remediation_hint: Repair the smallest broken reference and re-run the entire graph check.

evals.title: Research queue discipline
procedure: Trace every research-needed claim to a research task or completed inquiry.
Inspect methods, success criteria, limitations, and source boundaries.
pass_criteria: Every open consequential claim has an actionable research path.
Tasks distinguish recovery from nonexistence and chronology from causation.
Completed work records a bounded result.
evals.remediation_hint: Create a bounded research task with methods and success criteria instead of guessing.

evals.title: Collective credit and anti-claims
procedure: Review every collective-work claim for Jamie's specific contribution, collaborator and institution boundaries, and prohibited overstatements.
pass_criteria: Every collective claim has a boundary and anti-claim.
Supported action is not hidden behind vague team language.
Movement or policy outcomes are not converted into solo causation.
evals.remediation_hint: Name Jamie's action plainly, then state the collective and institutional boundary just as plainly.

evals.title: Projection discipline
procedure: Compare active public projections with claim eligibility, evidence, citation requirement, and registered page occurrence.
pass_criteria: Only eligible claims appear on public website surfaces.
Strong active claims require citations where context warrants.
Eligible knowledge may remain unprojected without being deleted.
evals.remediation_hint: Hold the projection or add the missing evidence and citation occurrence.

evals.title: Public-claim coverage and underclaiming review
procedure: Trace consequential public claims back to the bank.
Review eligible but unprojected claims as candidates for the current audience rather than automatic additions.
pass_criteria: Every consequential public claim has a bank record or approved proof record.
Strong eligible claims receive an explicit use-now or hold decision.
Depth does not force display.
evals.remediation_hint: Record the editorial disposition; compose for the audience instead of dumping the bank onto the page.

evals.title: Photo-to-research feedback loop
procedure: Inspect photo leads and participant-photo sources.
Verify metadata-only intake, research-task routing, and rights, consent, and display controls.
pass_criteria: A photo observation can become a research task without becoming a claim.
Uncleared pixels remain outside the public repository.
Any displayable photo records rights, consent, context, and claim relationship.
evals.remediation_hint: Route the observation through metadata-only intake and rights review before evidentiary or editorial use.
